title: Combi RFID Cards
description: Combi RFID cards with dual-frequency or multi-chip construction for migration projects, multi-application credentials and mixed-reader environments.
summary: Combi RFID cards combine two credential technologies in one card, making them useful for phased migration, mixed-reader estates and multi-purpose access or attendance programs.

Combi Cards often combine proximity or smartcard technology with long-range UHF (Ultra-High Frequency) technology. We have consider the interference between different chips, and make them work together perfectly.
Although it embedded with two or three technology, the space occupied remains the same as regular single chip cards.

faq.question: What are Combi RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for migration projects, mixed-reader estates, and multi-application credentials that need two technologies in a single card body.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Combi RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200 + MIFARE S50, or EM4200 +U8 Protocol: ISO14443 /ISO15693/ISO18000-6C etc. Frequency: LF+HF / HF+UHF / LF+UHF /LF+HF+UHF

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Combi RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG, ETC. Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or customized. Color: White. Black, green, blue, etc., can be customized.

faq.question: How can Combi RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Offset Printing, Silk-screen printing, UV printing, digital printing, etc Finishing Options: Number printing or laser engraving, Bar code, QR code, etc.
